integrity.dual_degree_basis: Benoist records Boole's formula for the singular-hypersurface discriminant degree; Kaji explicitly identifies Boole's formula as the degree formula for dual varieties of Veronese varieties.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1009.0704 lists version 1 on 2010-09-03.
integrity.primal_degree_basis: The Veronese hyperplane class pulls back to e times the hyperplane class on projective space, giving degree e^n.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source arXiv:1009.0704 is math.AG with MSC 14M10, 14N05, 14M25; Kaji's Veronese dual source is math.AG with MSC 14N05.

scientific_limitations: The theorem compares only the projective degree of a Veronese variety with the degree of its ordinary projective dual.
Higher polar, coisotropic, Euclidean-distance, and higher Gauss-map degrees are outside the claim.
The crossover follows by an elementary comparison of classical formulas, so an older or unindexed source may contain the same observation.
title: A sharp dual–primal degree crossover for Veronese varieties
